source.snippet: On GKE, nodes join fine on first boot, but a recreated node VM (spot preemption, auto-repair) can never rejoin the cluster. Seen on two separate clusters over the past month, on 1.35.5 (REGULAR channel) and 1.34.8-gke.1126000 (STABLE), and on different node pools: an on-demand default pool and a spot worker pool. Zonal private cluster in Europe with Shielded Nodes and Workload Identity. [CSRs] stay Pending ~14 min then get AutoDenied; auto-repair loops the pool forever.

problem_statement: DevOps teams running GKE with Shielded Nodes and spot/preemptible instances face a critical bug where recreated node VMs cannot rejoin clusters due to CSR auto-denial, causing auto-repair to loop indefinitely and effectively killing spot workloads.
target_segment: DevOps and platform engineers at companies running production GKE clusters with spot/preemptible nodes to reduce cloud costs.
notes: Single detailed report but affects two production clusters over a month — indicates real operational cost (spot pool unavailable = lost cost savings + degraded capacity). Companies using spot nodes specifically to reduce cloud spend; a monitoring/alerting or automated remediation tool for GKE CSR failures could command payment. Signal strength kept at 2 due to single source; watch for confirmation. Opportunity: a GKE-specific health monitor or auto-remediation script/service that detects and resolves CSR denial loops.
